title: 生物濾池污水處理
summary: 生物濾池讓水流經附著生物膜的介質；布水與通風維持反應，脫落生物膜仍需處理。學徒從預沉走到回流、傳質和終沉，區分過濾與生物轉化。
summaryEn: Trickling filters pass water over attached-film media; distribution and ventilation support reaction while sloughed biomass still needs treatment. Follow primary settling, recycle, transport and final settling, distinguishing filtration from conversion.

steps.title: 初沉前有機負荷：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Organic load before primary settling: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 初沉前有機負荷：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Organic load before primary settling: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「初沉前有機負荷」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at organic load before primary settling.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「初沉前有機負荷」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for organic load before primary settling; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.instruction: 進入濾床的氧氣只有一部分轉移到濕潤生物膜；空氣量足夠不代表分配均勻或氧已到達生物膜深處。本單元在「通風供氧需求」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Only part of the oxygen entering a filter transfers to the wet biofilm; enough air volume does not prove uniform distribution or oxygen penetration. Examine this relationship at ventilation oxygen demand.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：同一參考溫壓下空氣500 m³/h、含氧質量0.28 kg/m³、假設轉移比例0.10。公式 Otransfer=Qair cO2 ftransfer；代入 500*0.28*0.10 = 14 kg O₂/h。適用邊界：教學轉移比例須以實測校正；自然通風隨氣溫與濾床阻力變化，不能保證固定風量。
